commits.message:
Update READ

Added a note about potential misleading data from the API.
Refactor: moved configs object to the top of the file

Refactor: Rename file to `canteen.js` to align with project name

Feature: Update widget to display price for 100g of Salad (instead of 1kg)
Fix: Fallback canteen data was not displayed in the UI
added jsdoc for createErrorWidget

feature: add offline fallback and unified data fetching for widget

- Added getMenuData to fetch meals from the API or fall back to local cache
- Modified fetchAllMeals to return null on failure instead of throwing
- Modified loadDateData to return null on read failure
- Added createErrorWidget for graceful error display in the widget
- Updated createWidget to immediately set the widget via Script.setWidget
- Updated main to use getMenuData and error widget fallback when needed

- Implement saveDateData to persist current day's menu and associated date
- Implement getDateData to load cached data if it's still valid for the given day
- Add isValidJSONData to perform basic structure validation of cached content

Add local filesystem helpers for JSON storage and script data

- createLocalDirectory: ensures the script directory exists
- saveJSON: stores JSON data locally to reduce unnecessary API calls
- readJSON: reads and parses local JSON data
Bugfix

improved extractAllMeals-function: the user can now decide to fill up missing data from canteens with data from other canteens. If the user selected more canteens that provide data, the fallback canteens can be used.

Also created to helper functions for extractAllMeals to shorten it.

Added explanations for the new options in README.md

improved extractAllMeals-function: the user can now specify fallback-canteens. If there is no data available from the active canteens but from fallback canteens, the data from the fallback canteens will be used
new feature: if there is no data from the specified canteens but from other canteens, data from the other canteens will be shown
Added section about scrolling to README.md
replaced `=` with `:` in die Code example

improved readability of several functions by improving jsdoc and simplifying the code

added translations object to store all strings in one place
fixed wrong type annotation
added JSDoc-Strings and minor code improvements

Fix: Prevent script errors when no data is found

- Added check for empty data and handle accordingly.

- Found bug in the API where sausage price at counter 1 was incorrectly set to 0€. Script now detects and replaces the incorrect price with the actual value.
- Added "/kg" to the price display for the salad bar at counter 1.
- Widget updated to display active allergen filters.

Changed the actual error message in the widget to a generic message.
Moved `isMealValid` and the functions to shorten meal names to the helper functions section.
Added an option to always show the salad bar since it includes all allergens of all possible items you can choose there.
